record.bible_text: And in that day<WH03117> seven<WH07651> women<WH0802> shall take hold<WH02388><WTH8689> of one<WH0259> man<WH0376>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, We will eat<WH0398><WTH8799> our own bread<WH03899>, and wear<WH03847><WTH8799> our own apparel<WH08071>: only let us be called<WH07121><WTH8735> by thy name<WH08034>, to take away<WH0622><WTH8798> our reproach<WH02781>. <RF>let...: Heb. let thy name be called upon us<Rf> <RF>to take...: or, take thou away<Rf><CM>

In that day<WH03117> shall the branch<WH06780> of the LORD<WH03068> be beautiful<WH06643> and glorious<WH03519>, and the fruit<WH06529> of the earth<WH0776> <FI>shall be<Fi> excellent<WH01347> and comely for<WH08597> them that are escaped<WH06413> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>beautiful...: Heb. beauty and glory<Rf> <RF>them...: Heb. the escaping<Rf>

And it shall come to pass, <FI>that he that is<Fi> left<WH07604><WTH8737> in Zion<WH06726>, and <FI>he that<Fi> remaineth<WH03498><WTH8737> in Jerusalem<WH03389>, shall be called<WH0559><WTH8735> holy<WH06918>, <FI>even<Fi> every one that is written<WH03789><WTH8803> among the living<WH02416> in Jerusalem<WH03389>: <RF>among...: or, to life<Rf>

When the Lord<WH0136> shall have washed away<WH07364><WTH8804> the filth<WH06675> of the daughters<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726>, and shall have purged<WH01740><WTH8686> the blood<WH01818> of Jerusalem<WH03389> from the midst<WH07130> thereof by the spirit<WH07307> of judgment<WH04941>, and by the spirit<WH07307> of burning<WH01197><WTH8763>.

And the LORD<WH03068> will create<WH01254><WTH8804> upon every dwelling place<WH04349> of mount<WH02022> Zion<WH06726>, and upon her assemblies<WH04744>, a cloud<WH06051> and smoke<WH06227> by day<WH03119>, and the shining<WH05051> of a flaming<WH03852> fire<WH0784> by night<WH03915>: for upon all the glory<WH03519> <FI>shall be<Fi> a defence<WH02646>. <RF>upon all: or, above all<Rf> <RF>defence: Heb. covering<Rf>

And there shall be a tabernacle<WH05521> for a shadow<WH06738> in the daytime<WH03119> from the heat<WH02721>, and for a place of refuge<WH04268>, and for a covert<WH04563> from storm<WH02230> and from rain<WH04306>.<CM>
